name: Antispam
description: Holds or rejects spam comments before they are stored: too many links, a blocklist of words and sites, mixed alphabets, shouting, repeated text and first-time commenters with links. Optionally asks StopForumSpam about the commenter's IP and e-mail (off by default).
author: sap13ns

settings.label: Links before holding
settings.help: A comment with more links than this is held for moderation. 0 holds every comment with a link.

settings.label: Links for spam
settings.help: A comment with at least this many links is marked as spam. 0: never.

settings.label: Blocklist
settings.help: One word, phrase or domain per line (lines starting with # are notes). Matched in the content, the name, the website and the e-mail, ignoring case and accents. A single word matches whole words only.

settings.label: Blocklist action
settings.help: What happens to a comment that matches the blocklist.

settings.label: Alphabet check
settings.help: mixed holds words that mix Latin with Cyrillic or Greek letters (a trick to dodge filters). latin also holds comments written mostly in other alphabets: use it only if your readers write in Latin script.

settings.label: Hold shouting
settings.help: Hold comments written mostly in capital letters.

settings.label: Hold repeated text
settings.help: Hold comments with a character repeated 8 times or a word repeated 6 times in a row.

settings.label: Hold first comments with links
settings.help: Hold a comment with a link from someone who is not signed in and whose e-mail address has never had a comment approved.

settings.label: Log accepted comments
settings.help: Also write comments that pass every check to the activity log. Held and spam comments are always logged.

settings.label: Ask StopForumSpam
settings.help: Send the commenter's IP address and a hash of their e-mail address to stopforumspam.org, a third party. Mention it in your privacy policy before turning it on.

settings.label: StopForumSpam: e-mail
settings.help: Look up the MD5 hash of the e-mail address (the address itself is never sent).

settings.label: StopForumSpam: spam confidence
settings.help: A listing with at least this confidence (1–100) marks the comment as spam; a weaker listing holds it.
